pairs.question: Illa enim regnum amisit, haec retinet; illa interfectione regis orbata, haec incolumi imperatore secura est. Et hoc quare?
pairs.answer: Quoniam ibi in rege libidinum turpitudo punita, hic Christianae religionis continentissima aequitas in rege seruata est.
pairs.derivation: Authorial rhetorical question 'et hoc quare?' answered by the author himself with 'quoniam ...'. Setup from section 6 ('illa enim regnum amisit ... secura est') is kept so 'hoc' has a referent (the Babylon/Rome contrast). Answer stops at the first full stop ('seruata est'); the following semicolon-clause 'ibi absque religionis reuerentia auiditatem uoluptatis ...' elaborates the same point rather than answering, so it is cut.
